About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Financial Partnerships team sits within the Global Partnerships organization and is a key component of our success. Our team is responsible for developing and managing relationships with the global and regional banks that enable the Stripe product strategy and deliver new capabilities to Stripe users.

Our team executes on high-impact, cross-functional product partnership initiatives across existing products and early-stage "up the stack" financial products. These partnerships have a significant impact on Stripe and are essential for us to offer products used by millions of our users.

We're looking for a Partner Development Manager to join the Financial Partnerships team. You'll be responsible for developing and executing the multi-year, global strategies for building our relationships across many of our most important banking partners.

You'll focus on designing, scaling, and continuously improving mechanisms to deepen relationships with our partners, as well as highly impactful programs key to differentiating Stripe.

As part of these efforts, you'll collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, etc.), and with the banking partners' executive teams.
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated ability to manage and develop partners, think strategically and apply diagnostic thinking to business, product, and technical challenges, and earn trust with and influence others. A high-agency attitude, the ability to raise expectations in changing environments, and a drive to create impact through ownership are all important in this role.

Develop the go-to-partner strategy and execute on our most ambitious company-bending, bank-network-driven projects that are global and cross-border in nature
Own the banking partner plans, the overall economics, day-to-day operational excellence, and be responsible for driving the partnerships to successful outcomes for Stripe
Leverage banking, treasury, and payments industry knowledge to craft thoughtful partnership and product strategies with transaction banks, lenders, capital markets, central banks, and schemes
Navigate, in partnership with Product, to execute deals supporting that strategy and help ensure a proper execution plan is in place
Leverage significant industry experience to educate and help internal teams compose our holistic bank-led strategy and to advance that strategy with banking partners

Advanced knowledge of the banking and clearing landscape across multiple geographies with specific focus on transaction banking, e-money, safeguarding, multi-currency, and cross-border payments
Demonstrated experience building proprietary global collection and payout networks
A proven track record of working in a product-centric environment with significant internal and external dependencies across product, engineering, legal, sales, risk, and compliance

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. The Financial Connections team sources, develops, and manages relationships with our most critical financial institutions, banking, and ecosystem partners. Our team drives the expansion of Stripe's merchant and consumer offerings by building partnerships with the leading companies in these areas.

Our team executes on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives with these partners across new product initiatives. These partnerships have a significant impact on Stripe and the products used by millions of our users.

We are looking for a Partner Development Manager who will be responsible for driving our open banking partnership strategy and executing partnerships with top financial institutions in support of Stripe's Financial Connections business (stripe.com/financial-connections).

You will focus on growing our portfolio of partners with the largest banks and credit unions in the US, expanding Stripe's direct connectivity coverage to ensure consumers have seamless access to their financial data.

You will own end-to-end deal strategy and execution—from sourcing and qualification through negotiation and launch—with many of the top financial institutions across North America. As part of these efforts, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, and others.

You will also lead relationship management, partnering closely with external partners' executive leadership to grow our mutual businesses together over the long term.

· Own a partnership portfolio of top financial institutions and drive them through the full partnership lifecycle from initial outreach to scaled growth on Financial Connections

· Leverage deep knowledge of the open banking ecosystem to guide internal cross-functional stakeholders (including product, risk, compliance, engineering, security) through an evolving business and regulatory landscape, implementing thoughtful partnership strategies that accelerate Stripe's connectivity across the financial ecosystem

· Identify and effectively analyze new partnership opportunities, ultimately making recommendations to relevant decision makers and cross-functional stakeholders

· Negotiate strategic partnership agreements with banks and credit unions, navigating complex legal, compliance, and technical requirements

· Develop and maintain executive-level relationships at key financial institutions, partnering with Stripe leadership on strategic long term objectives

· Exhibit an operationally focused mindset, with an ability to lead teams through complex relationship management activities by setting a clear vision, and running tight processes

You are a skilled deal maker and a strategist by nature. You understand how to work closely with Product and Engineering teams and can formulate partner strategies that drive tangible and measurable results. You are genuinely motivated by the vision of open banking, where consumers have the freedom to access, share and use their financial data with any technology platform they choose.

· Experience negotiating commercial deals with financial institutions, including bilateral data access or API agreements

· Exceptionally strong communication skills, in both verbal and written form, and ability to influence stakeholders across a wide variety of functions, including at executive levels

· Technical acumen, especially an ability to understand product strategy and use this understanding to define requirements for scaling products through partnerships

· Experience developing partnership strategies and identifying, sourcing, and analyzing new partnership opportunities

· Strong agency, can handle ambiguity in a fast-moving organization, and thrives on a high level of autonomy and responsibility

· 5+ years of experience working directly with banks, credit unions, or fintechs on data access, open banking, or API connectivity initiatives

· Familiarity with open banking standards (FDX), regulatory frameworks (CFPB 1033), and the competitive landscape of financial data aggregation

· Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder deal processes involving legal, compliance, information security, and technical integration teams at large financial institutions

Join us if you are excited about redefining B2B entertainment, build global partnerships, and turn world-class culture into a seamless business service.

Drive inbound and outbound pipeline for Fever for Business’ corporate ticketing offering.
Manage and close group ticket sales opportunities, leading the full sales cycle from qualification to payment reception.
Build and optimize outreach sequences, messaging, and cadences to maximize engagement and conversion.
Maintain excellent CRM hygiene and ensure accurate forecasting to keep the team aligned on targets.
Collaborate closely with Billing, with the various Project Managers, and with the Sales team to align campaigns, share insights, and enhance commercial impact.
Track and report key KPIs (SQLs generated, pipeline value, conversion rates, closed-won revenue) and iterate based on performance data.

3 months: Ramp up on our offering, tools, and messaging. Start closing your first group ticket sales and meet early pipeline targets.
6 months: Consistently generate, qualify, and advance high-quality opportunities for ticketed experiences within companies and institutions. Improve conversion rates through disciplined follow-up and data-driven iteration.
12 months: Become a key revenue driver for Fever for Business, supported by a repeatable sales playbook and strong internal partnerships that accelerate results. Be prepared for promotion.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong negotiation and problem-solving abilities.
Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, can-do attitude.
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and building processes from scratch.
Creative thinker with strong data-driven decision-making skills.
Skilled in crafting presentations and written pitch materials.
Fluency in English ; additional languages are a strong plus.

Attractive compensation package consisting of an OTE of $65,000 with room to grow.
40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.

Private health, dental and vision insurance with Cigna.

Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

We are looking for an exceptional, entrepreneurial Global Licensing Manager to join our dynamic and fast-paced Licensing team.
This is a high-impact business development role for someone with a strong commercial mindset and a passion for the entertainment industry. You will lead the expansion of our portfolio of live-event IPs across several international regions—identifying new opportunities, creating conversations with potential partners, and structuring partnerships that unlock sustainable growth.

As Global Licensing Manager, you will own the commercial development of assigned regions end-to-end: from mapping markets and originating new partner conversations to negotiating licensing agreements and coordinating their successful launch internally.
You will act as the face of the Licensing team in the market and bring market intelligence back into the organization, helping shape our international growth strategy and identify the next generation of licensing opportunities.

Develop and execute the business development strategy for assigned international regions, identifying high-potential markets, partners, and commercial opportunities.
Proactively source, approach, and build relationships with promoters, producers, agencies, venue operators, and other relevant partners.
Lead outbound commercial conversations and manage the full deal pipeline, from initial outreach through proposal development, negotiation, and contract execution.
Create tailored commercial proposals and licensing structures for different IPs, territories, and partner profiles.
Assess the commercial viability of opportunities through revenue, cost, and profitability analysis, working closely with Finance and other internal stakeholders.
Negotiate commercial terms that balance growth, profitability, brand protection, and long-term partner value.
Manage a portfolio of prospective and active partners, building trusted relationships and identifying opportunities to expand successful collaborations.
Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Production teams to ensure smooth deal execution and successful launches.
Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and new entertainment formats to inform licensing strategy and identify whitespace opportunities.
Maintain rigorous pipeline reporting, regularly presenting commercial progress, forecasts, and key decisions to leadership.

4+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, consulting, investment banking, strategic roles, or a similar commercial environment.
Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior-level relationships, and lead complex commercial conversations from first contact to close.
Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with the ability to structure compelling, mutually beneficial partnerships.
Analytical and financially minded, with experience building business cases, evaluating P&Ls, and assessing the profitability of new opportunities.
Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable operating with ownership in a fast-paced, international environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and credibly to internal and external stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deals, stakeholders, and priorities across regions.
Professional working proficiency in English is required. Additional languages are a strong plus.
A genuine interest in live entertainment, experiential formats, and building global IPs is highly valued.

Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Ernährungsberater:in mit in der Schweiz anerkannter Qualifikation zur Abrechnung ärztlich verordneter Ernährungsberatungen
* Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich klinische Ernährung
* Erfahrung in der ambulanten oder in der Langzeitpflege von Vorteil
